research_basis.finding: Relative Lempel-Ziv methods exploit similarity across related document collections, motivating deterministic cross-record neighborhood formation rather than another local token model.
LZ77 is especially effective on repetitive software repositories and versioned document collections, but record order can determine which repetitions become nearby to a bounded backend.
The preceding exact LZP-before-TPAQX decomposition screen failed, so this successor tests cross-record ordering rather than repeating explicit left-only factorization.

variants.purpose: Test whether exact bounded content-similarity ordering creates backend-visible neighborhoods beyond the prior demux representation.
variants.representation: AXRN1 canonical metadata plus class-scoped four-seed bounded sampled-window minhash ordering
